brief: The canvas displays a textured brick wall painted in earth tones of red and brown. Emerald and forest green vines cling naturally to the masonry, with tendrils and leaves continuously shifting and blooming, simulating slow, biological growth across the entire surface. The movement is organic and subtle, depicting the slow creep of vegetation over time. While the growth proceeds independently, a click anywhere on the wall prompts a sudden, concentrated burst of vibrant new foliage originating from that point, increasing the density and variety of the covering.
